main_measure.name: slope of 14-bar excess forward return on forecast (forecast > 0 grid cells, pooled)

statistic.name: OLS slope t, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope t >= 2 and mean excess > 0; reject: slope t <= -2 or mean excess t <= -2; at least 100 cells

supporting_check.name: mean excess 14-bar return over the same cells > 0

decided_by: Confirm rule met: the slope's t is 2 or more and the mean excess return is above 0.
reading: The choppy calm profile is read from the recorded regime (the detector's default 'unknown', i.e. no veto) since the detector's components are not recorded and its 365-bar lookback cannot be rebuilt in a window, the rise from the raw weekly_rise value (or its price rebuild where missing); the coin's mean 14-bar return is taken over all its grid cells in all windows, and both t's cluster cases by UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction.

direction_check.why: too few cases on the check folds (58 cases, 58 days)
